For this mediation analysis, we ask: "How much of the treatment effect of Dexamethasone on survival is mediated through the biomarker slope?"
the workflow is conducted as: 
Posterior slope draw (joint model) -> Mediation model -> Effect estimate

```{r}
#> Prepare function
source("~/hanhnlm/metabolomics/script/subject_slope_extract.R")
source("~/hanhnlm/metabolomics/script/mediation_function.R")
safe_extract <- function(res, row, col) {
    if (row %in% rownames(res) && col %in% colnames(res)) {
      return(res[row, col])
    } else {
      return(NA)
    }
}
summarize_mediation1 <- function(df, N, k) {
  pool_one <- function(est, lwr, upr, name = "") {
    keep <- complete.cases(est, lwr, upr)
    est <- est[keep]
    lwr <- lwr[keep]
    upr <- upr[keep]
    
    m <- length(est)
    
    # Log transformation
    log_est <- log(est)
    log_lwr <- log(lwr)
    log_upr <- log(upr)
    
    # SE from CI
    se <- (log_upr - log_lwr) / (2 * 1.96)
    var <- se^2
    
    # RR pooling
    theta_bar <- mean(log_est)
    W <- mean(var)
    B <- var(log_est)
    T_var <- W + (1 + 1/m) * B
    se_total <- sqrt(T_var)
    
    # Barnard-Rubin df
    RIV <- ifelse(W > 0, ((1 + 1/m)*B) / W, NA)
    lambda <- ((1 + 1/m)*B) / T_var
    
    df_old <- (m - 1) * (1 + 1/RIV)^2
    df_complete <- N - k
    df_obs <- (df_complete + 1) / (df_complete + 3) * df_complete * (1 - lambda)
    df_adj <- df_old * df_obs / (df_old + df_obs)
    
    t_crit <- qt(0.975, df = df_adj)
    
    log_lower <- theta_bar - t_crit * se_total
    log_upper <- theta_bar + t_crit * se_total
    
    t_stat <- theta_bar / se_total
    p_val <- 2 * (1 - pt(abs(t_stat), df = df_adj))
    
    # Back-transform
    rubin_HR <- exp(theta_bar)
    CI_lower <- exp(log_lower)
    CI_upper <- exp(log_upper)
    
    # Diagnostics
    skew_log <- mean((log_est - mean(log_est))^3) / sd(log_est)^3
    normal_flag <- ifelse(abs(skew_log) < 0.5, "approx normal", "skewed")
    
    # Plots
    plot_df <- data.frame(log_est = log_est)
    
    p_qq <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(sample = log_est)) + 
      stat_qq() + stat_qq_line(color = "#A62C2A") +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(title = paste0(name, " log-scale Q-Q plot"))
    
    p_log_density <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = log_est)) +
      geom_density(fill = "#B2C1D6", alpha = 0.5) +
      stat_function(
        fun = dnorm,
        args = list(mean = mean(log_est), sd = sd(log_est)),
        color = "#A62C2A",
        linewidth = 1
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(name, " log-scale density"),
        subtitle = "Blue = empirical, Red = normal",
        x = "Log(HR)",
        y = "Density"
      ) + 
      theme_bw()
    
    list(
      summary = tibble(
        Effect = name,
        HR = rubin_HR,
        CI_lower = CI_lower,
        CI_upper = CI_upper,
        SE = se_total,
        DF = df_adj,
        P_value = p_val,
        WithinVar = W,
        BetweenVar = B,
        TotalVar = T_var,
        RIV = RIV,
        FMI = lambda,
        LogSkewness = skew_log,
        LogNormality = normal_flag
      ),
      qqplot = p_qq,
      log_density = p_log_density
    )
  }
  # Effects
  res_TE  <- pool_one(df$TE_est, df$TE_lwr, df$TE_upr, "TE")
  res_NDE <- pool_one(df$NDE_est, df$NDE_lwr, df$NDE_upr, "NDE")
  res_NIE <- pool_one(df$NIE_est, df$NIE_lwr, df$NIE_upr, "NIE")
  
  # PM (empirical)
  pm_est <- df$PM_est
  pm_summary <- tibble(
    Effect = "PM",
    HR = median(pm_est, na.rm = TRUE),
    CI_lower = quantile(pm_est, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    CI_upper = quantile(pm_est, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  list(
    table = bind_rows(
      res_TE$summary,
      res_NDE$summary,
      res_NIE$summary,
      pm_summary
    ),
    qqplots = list(
      TE = res_TE$qqplot,
      NDE = res_NDE$qqplot,
      NIE = res_NIE$qqplot
    ),
    logdensplots = list(
      TE = res_TE$log_density,
      NDE = res_NDE$log_density,
      NIE = res_NIE$log_density
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
})

original_names <- names(dat_long)

  original_names,
  make.names(original_names))
```

For each metabolite:slope_mat → mediation → summary → combine all metabolites
```{r}
target_mets <- c(
  "Tryptophan",
  "Kynurenine",
  "KynurenicAcid",
  "AntranilicAcid",
  "Alanine"
)
cmest_args <- modifyList(
  default_cmest,
  list(
    model = "gformula",
    basec = c("AGE","SEX","LTA4H","TBMGRADE","CSFWBC","CSFPROTEIN"),
    mreg = list("linear"),
    yreg = "coxph",
    nboot = 500,
    a = "Dexamethasone",
    astar = "Placebo"
  )
)
mediation_results_12m <- lapply(target_mets, function(met_name) {
  message("Running mediation for: ", met_name)
  res <- run_mediation(
    slope_mat = subject_slopes_list[[met_name]],
    analysis_df = dat_surv,
    cmest_args = cmest_args,
    n_draws = 2000
  )
  df <- res$draws
  df$metabolite <- met_name
  df
})
#> saving results: list of mediation results
#> 
names(mediation_results_12m) <- target_mets
save(mediation_results_12m, file = file.path("/home/hanhnlm@oucru.org/hanhnlm/metabolomics/deriveddata/MediationAnalysis_27TB_July202026.RData"))
```

## Result parsing
```{r}
load(file.path(output.dir, "MediationAnalysis_27TB_July202026.RData"))
names(mediation_results)
lapply(mediation_results, function(col) table(col$warning, useNA = "ifany"))
warning_summary <- sapply(mediation_results, function(col) {
  c(
    n_warning = sum(!is.na(col$warning)),
    n_total = nrow(col)
  )
}) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
warning_summary
#> remove non-convert iteration
mediation_results_clean <- lapply(mediation_results, function(col) {
  col %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(warning) |warning == "")
})
lapply(mediation_results_clean, function(col) dim(col))
#> The extracted effects are ration measures already (Rte, Rtnde, Rtnie, Rpnde, Rpnie)
```

```{r summary_and_diagnosis}
#> A hazard ratio (HR) of 1 means there is no difference in the risk of an event occurring between two groups being compared.
N <- length(unique(analysis_df$Subject_id))
k <- length(coef(cox_27))
all_summary <- lapply(
  mediation_results_clean,
  function(x) summarize_mediation1(x, N = N, k = k)
)
save(all_summary, file = file.path(output.dir, "CMAverse_summary.RData"))

#> In the table
##> Empirical inference (this is the primary result, directly drawn from the posterior-based approach). The log-HR across 1k posterior draws and mediation estimates was estimated by taking the median of the distribution, storing in the estimate_log column. Along with the median of estimates, the 95% credible interval was inferred, storing in CI_upper_log and CI_lower_log. For a more easier interpretation, the HR and HR CrI was estimated by taking the exponential of the **_log columns. In the agreement with the Bayesian framework, I report the posterior probability (P_log_gt0 and P_exp_gt1). Besides, I also provide the Rubin pooling estimates (Rubin_*) assuming normality and the Rubin_p is the frequentist-style p-value for hypothesis testing. It should be noted down that the estimates was pooled under the log scaled data, before being exponentiated.
```

```{r group_forest}
df_group_forest <- map_dfr(
  names(all_summary),
  function(met) {
    all_summary[[met]]$table %>%
      dplyr::filter(Effect %in% c("TE", "NDE", "NIE")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Metabolite = met)
  }
)
df_group_forest <- df_group_forest %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Effect = factor(Effect, levels = c("TE", "NIE", "NDE")),
    label = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]; p=%.3f",
                    HR, CI_lower, CI_upper, P_value),
    Metabolite = factor(Metabolite)
  ) %>% dplyr::filter(Metabolite %in% c("Tryptophan","Kynurenine","KynurenicAcid","AntranilicAcid","Alanine"))
ggplot(df_group_forest, aes(x = HR, y = Metabolite, color = Effect)) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_text(
      aes(label = label), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), vjust = -0.5,
      fontface = "bold", show.legend = F) + 
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = CI_lower, xmax = CI_upper),
    orientation = "y",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    width = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") + 
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(0.25, 0.5, 1, 2),
    limits = c(0.25, 3)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "TE" = "#A62C2A",
    "NIE" = "#0072B2",
    "NDE" = "#009E73"
  )) + 
  labs(
    x = "Hazard Ratio (HR)",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Effect"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_text(face="bold", colour="black", size=12),
          axis.title.y = element_text(face="bold", colour="black", size=12),
          axis.text.y = element_text(face="bold", colour="black", size=13),
          axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold", colour="black", size=13),
          axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
          legend.title = element_text( colour="black", size=15),
          strip.text=element_text(face = "bold",size=12)) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,face="bold", colour="black", size=20))
```
